commentaries.author: parimēlaḻagar
commentaries.text:
Reunited, he shows her fresh delight for many days, and she fears it means something. He reads this from her signs and speaks to her.

You say nothing and hide it, but your eyes won’t agree. They slip from your control, and there is something they are trying to tell me. Now say it plainly yourself. Hiding here means holding back out of modesty. She has changed because she thinks he means to leave. He sees it from her signs, and lets her know he doesn’t.
